name: hcphp
description: Skills that ship with the HCPHP foundation, for the applications built on it.

plugins.name: hcphp
plugins.description: Skills for applications built on the HCPHP foundation: /hcphp:port (carry HCPHP's fixes into an application, scan it for its own security holes, and track the result in that application), /hcphp:refactor-plan (measure the application and plan a behaviour-preserving refactoring toward single-responsibility services and constructor injection) and /hcphp:refactor-run (carry the approved plan out one slice per pull request, with characterization tests, mutation checks and running-app verification).
